# citation.is

> Agent-native website agency. We build marketing sites for AI startups, agent platforms, and developer tools — engineered to be cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews. Fixed price. 48-hour delivery. Score-first proof.

Not affiliated with grow.com. Operated by Gudmundur Eyberg Kristjansson.

## Sub-contexts (read these for depth)

- [Standard](https://citation.is/standard/llms.txt): The Agent-Native Web Standard (geo-standard@2026.07) — five signals, Verifiability Layer, thresholds, crawler matrix.
- [Leaderboard](https://citation.is/leaderboard/llms.txt): Open dataset — 390+ AI companies scored. Methodology, headline stats, JSON API.
- [Data](https://citation.is/data/llms.txt): Raw data directory — live API endpoints + Q2-2026 archive snapshots. CC BY 4.0.
